text: Four friends. A hundred dollars each, every round. And each round, one of them takes the whole pot.
It works. Until someone takes the pot early, and stops paying. That's where savings circles break.
This is Round. Savings circles on Mezo, where everyone saves in MUSD, and locks Bitcoin as their promise.
To join, you lock Bitcoin worth one and a half times what you could owe. Mezo's price feed sets the amount.
Each round, you pay MUSD with one signature. When the round is due, anyone can settle, and the pot goes out.
Now, member one takes the first pot, then skips round two.
After the grace period, Round takes the missed payment from their locked Bitcoin, plus a ten percent penalty. Member two still gets paid.
No admin. No middleman. The group stays whole.
Round. Save together in dollars. Keep your Bitcoin.
